title: Watergate Salad
description: Pistachio pudding fluff with pineapple, marshmallows, pecans and maraschino cherries, chilled overnight.

ingredients.name: maraschino cherries
ingredients.note: for the top, patted very dry

steps.title: Mix base
steps.text: In a large bowl, stir {pudding} into {pineapple} with its juice. Do not drain the pineapple; the juice is what activates the pudding. Stir 2 minutes.

steps.title: Fold in Cool Whip
steps.text: Gently fold in {coolwhip} until no streaks remain.

steps.title: Chill overnight
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate overnight. The marshmallows soften and the flavors meld.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.text: Before serving, top with {cherrytop} patted dry so the red does not bleed into the green.

notes: Quantities are starting points (the saved version had no amounts). Green and red together is essential for presentation. Make the night before; chilling overnight is required, not optional. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/10 of recipe): 230 kcal, 1.2 g protein, 36.5 g total carbohydrate, 9.8 g fat, 1.3 g fiber, 153 mg sodium. Based on the measured ingredients; brands and optional additions can change these values.

steps.title: Fit the paddle
steps.text: Use the stand mixer on its lowest speed for the pudding and pineapple only. Stop and scrape twice. Fold cream, nuts and fruit by hand to retain air.

steps.title: Mix base
steps.text: In the stand mixer bowl, combine {pudding} and {pineapple} on low for 30–45 seconds until evenly moistened.

steps.title: Fold in Cool Whip
steps.text: Gently fold in {coolwhip} until no streaks remain.

steps.title: Chill overnight
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate overnight. The marshmallows soften and the flavors meld.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.text: Before serving, top with {cherrytop} patted dry so the red does not bleed into the green.
